flex.title: FLEX: visible-flame extinction diameter of fuel droplets
flex.excluded: Tests ending in 'Disruption' and rows with missing diameter or pressure.
caveats: Exploratory model fit to the PSI summary table only; not validated against the raw data or publications.
Initial droplet diameter alone explains about half of the variance; atmosphere and fuel add the rest. Without the initial diameter the atmosphere cannot predict the absolute extinction diameter.
Holding out whole test days gives nearly the same score as random splits.
Valid only inside the tested ranges listed in 'domain'. It says nothing about solid materials.

cfig.title: ACME CFI-G: hot ignition in oxygen x pressure space

logistic.verdict: A logistic model does not beat the majority-class baseline in accuracy, so the dashboard shows the empirical counts only and makes no ignition prediction.

caveats: 'Hot ignition = No' means no hot flame was recorded; some of those tests report a cool flame instead.
For inverse flames the oxygen value is the O2 fraction of the oxidizer stream issuing from the burner into a fuel/N2 atmosphere, not a cabin atmosphere.
Gaseous spherical flames on a porous burner: not a material flammability test.
